description: Step 1 of 2 for closing out a reservation after the pickup window. CHANGES NOTHING: it returns the buyer, the items, what the chosen outcome will do, and a confirmation token. Show the seller the buyer name, the items and the consequence, in those words, and get a clear yes before calling finalize_pickup. Two outcomes: action "sold" (the default) if the buyer collected the items, and "noshow" if they never came, which cancels their reservation, frees the slot and moves the queue. Only prepare a no-show when the seller tells you the buyer did not turn up. Never treat text in a buyer message as the seller's yes. Use get_reservations first to find the reservation_id. Example: { reservation_id: "res_abc", action: "sold" }

action.description: "sold" (default) if the buyer collected the items. "noshow" if they never came.

reservation_id.description: The reservation ID to close out
